stakeholder: software developer who will modify the seat booking functionality
perspective: understand the high-level architecture of the seat booking functionality before changing the code, to identify which parts need to be modified and which other components may be affected by introducing new booking rules
concerns: Which are the main components involved in the booking process and what is each one responsible for?
How do the components interact and depend on each other?
Which components manage and store reservations?
Which components interact with external services such as the notification service?
Which parts of the system need to be modified for the new booking rules, and which other components may be affected?
